brief:
Writer Wisam Afifa said the Palestinian agreement to postpone elections to September 2027 presents a political paradox, with Fatah, Hamas, and other factions deferring the electoral contest even as opinion polls suggest shifts in Palestinian public opinion, Shehab Wire reported. Afifa characterized the delay as avoiding a potential assessment of changes in street sentiment that elections might reveal.

The postponement agreement came as Palestinian factions sought consensus on electoral timing amid ongoing political divisions.

title: Palestinian factions postpone elections to 2027, delaying test of street sentiment
